name: Leadership Update (SCR)
description: Outcome-first SCR summary for leadership, GMD and investor-facing discussions.

sections.title: So What
sections.instruction: One or two sentences leading with the single most important outcome or decision. Use actual numbers, no vague words like significant or strong.

sections.title: Situation
sections.instruction: One crisp line of context only. Assume the audience is fully briefed.

sections.title: Complication
sections.instruction: What is blocking, at risk or off-track. Include numbers, owners and cities where stated. Flag any figure that was estimated.

sections.title: Resolution
sections.instruction: Decisions made and the agreed approach. State outcomes, not process.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Every assigned task with owner and a specific deadline. If no deadline was stated write 'Not set'. Add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Action | Deadline | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
